title: SandboxControl interface and NativeSandboxControl
description:
Implement the SandboxControl interface and NativeSandboxControl (wrapping sandbox-host RPCs).

Sections: 6 (SandboxControl Interface), 6.1 (Native Implementation), 6.2 (Cloud placeholder)

Key deliverables:
- internal/sandbox/control/control.go — SandboxControl interface, all request/response types
  (CreateSandboxRequest/Response, LaunchProcessRequest/Response, KillProcessRequest,
  GetProcessStatusRequest/Response, ProcessStatus, SandboxCapabilities, ResourceSpec),
  AddressToURL() helper
- internal/sandbox/control/native/native.go — NativeSandboxControl wrapping sandboxClient:
  - CreateSandbox -> CreateSession (field mapping: Template->BaseSnapshot, Labels->Labels,
    Resources->logged, Quota->WithDefaultQuota)
  - DestroySandbox -> DestroySession
  - PauseSandbox -> PauseSession
  - ResumeSandbox -> ResumeSession
  - LaunchProcess -> new LaunchProcess RPC (depends on add03 implementation)
  - KillProcess -> KillProcess RPC
  - GetProcessStatus -> GetProcessStatus RPC
  - Capabilities() returns SandboxCapabilities with native sandbox flags
- internal/sandbox/control/cloud/ — CloudSandboxControl placeholder (interface + stub)
- Unit tests with mock sandbox-host for all SandboxControl methods
- Note: LaunchProcess/KillProcess/GetProcessStatus depend on sandbox-host add03 (aiag-rmv.7).
  CreateSandbox/DestroySandbox/PauseSandbox/ResumeSandbox can proceed immediately.

References:
- Plan: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc.md §6, §6.1, §6.2
- Test harness: docs/plans/18-agent-loop-rpc-test-harness.md §10 (SC1-SC4)
- Depends on: aiag-rmv.3 (RPC transport), aiag-rmv.7 (sandbox-host LaunchProcess RPCs)
